rules: Every physical case must target the exact candidate commit, backend deploy and iOS build.
Every physical case must include a trace id, observed device state and a local evidence file whose SHA-256 is verified.
The iOS artifact path must exist and its measured SHA-256 must match the candidate.
No hard failure, unverified result or failed physical case can be averaged away.
The evaluator integrity gate must detect every declared historical mutation.
A compiled build is not a distributed or physically verified build.
